name: Okular
author: KDE e.V.
description: Multi-platform, fast and packed with features, Okular allows you to read PDF documents, comics and EPub books, browse images, visualize Markdown documents, and much more.

- Fix saving files on Windows. Commit. Fixes bug #458574
- ToggleActions: Obey “don't show text” for a particular action toolbar setting. Commit. Fixes bug #457322
- Even more tweaks to opening “text” files. Commit. Fixes bug #430538. Fixes bug #456434
- Epub: Improve TableOfContents for some files. Commit. Fixes bug #458289

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
